statusPolicy: No rule may be approved without internal image validation.

rules.name: Uploaded Portrait Source of Truth
rules.purpose: Anchor the edit to the uploaded person rather than inventing a replacement.
rules.promptRole: Declares which input controls identity.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: May reduce reference ambiguity; official image-editing capability supports using image inputs, but wording effect is unvalidated.

rules.name: Recognizable Same Person
rules.purpose: Prevent face replacement.
rules.promptRole: Sets identity continuity as an invariant.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Aligned with official subject-consistency capability; exact gain requires testing.

rules.name: Facial Geometry Invariants
rules.purpose: Keep feature shapes and proportions stable during restyling.
rules.promptRole: Expands vague face preservation into testable structure.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Expected to reduce eye, nose, jaw and proportion drift; unvalidated.

rules.name: Characteristic Impression Preservation
rules.purpose: Preserve recognizable affect while allowing category-level expression changes.
rules.promptRole: Separates identity-bearing impression from requested smile intensity.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: May prevent stock-smile drift; unvalidated.

rules.name: Hair Identity Preservation
rules.purpose: Prevent grooming language from replacing hairstyle.
rules.promptRole: Protects hairline, parting, length and texture except authorized cleanup.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Expected to reduce hairstyle drift; unvalidated.

rules.name: Grooming Delta Only
rules.purpose: Allow tidiness improvements without changing hairstyle identity.
rules.promptRole: Defines a narrow edit boundary for flyaways and neatness.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: May reduce overbroad hair edits; unvalidated.

rules.name: Natural Skin Tone
rules.purpose: Prevent orange, gray or artificially bright skin.
rules.promptRole: Keeps skin chroma tied to the input.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Expected tone fidelity; unvalidated.

rules.name: Restrained Retouch
rules.purpose: Avoid over-beautification while permitting cleanup.
rules.promptRole: Sets a low retouch intensity in positive language.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Positive framing aligns with official guidance; portrait effect unvalidated.

rules.name: Front Head Orientation
rules.purpose: Keep the face readable and symmetric for ID-style output.
rules.promptRole: Controls head direction independently of gaze.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Specific composition language aligns with official guidance; pose correction may alter identity.

rules.name: Lens Gaze
rules.purpose: Make both eyes address the camera.
rules.promptRole: Controls eye target independently of head angle.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Expected clearer intent when separated from pose; unvalidated.

rules.name: Expression Envelope
rules.purpose: Bound smile intensity by service type.
rules.promptRole: Allows warm, restrained or near-neutral expressions without uncontrolled mouth changes.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: May reduce teeth and mouth geometry artifacts; unvalidated.

rules.name: Authorized Wardrobe Preset
rules.purpose: Apply role-appropriate clothing only when wardrobe edits are allowed.
rules.promptRole: Supplies jacket, shirt and color variables under an authorization flag.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Specificity aligns with official guidance; collar artifacts and identity drift remain possible.

rules.name: Plain Background Preset
rules.purpose: Create an uncluttered category-appropriate backdrop.
rules.promptRole: Sets a parameterized solid or neutral studio color.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Concrete context description aligns with official guidance; legal document suitability is separate.

rules.name: Soft Even Studio Light
rules.purpose: Keep facial information readable with controlled contrast.
rules.promptRole: Defines soft diffusion and even exposure.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Lighting specificity is officially recommended; exact portrait outcome unvalidated.

rules.name: Minimal Natural Shadow
rules.purpose: Avoid harsh shadows without producing a flat cutout.
rules.promptRole: Reframes absolute shadow removal as a low, plausible shadow target.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Positive state may outperform a negative prohibition; requires A/B.

rules.name: Chest-up Centered Crop
rules.purpose: Standardize subject scale and placement.
rules.promptRole: Defines centered chest-up framing without claiming legal compliance.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Concrete composition control aligns with official guidance.

rules.name: Aspect Ratio via Output Config
rules.purpose: Produce the requested frame ratio reliably.
rules.promptRole: Moves supported output geometry from prose to API configuration.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Official API supports aspect ratio configuration for NB2 and Pro.

rules.name: Text and Watermark Exclusion
rules.purpose: Prevent unintended text overlays and visible marks.
rules.promptRole: Adds short output exclusions and separate evaluation checks.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Expected to reduce unwanted overlays; no guarantee because generated images carry platform provenance mechanisms.

rules.name: Unspecified Attributes Locked
rules.purpose: Prevent collateral edits.
rules.promptRole: Locks all properties not explicitly authorized.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Consistent with official edit examples that request one change while preserving other elements.

rules.name: Reference Role Assignment
rules.purpose: Prevent subject, scene and insert images from being mixed.
rules.promptRole: Maps each input index to a semantic role and protected attributes.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Official multi-reference support makes this applicable; wording effect unvalidated.

rules.name: Occlusion and Contact Order
rules.purpose: Preserve believable front/back relationships at contact points.
rules.promptRole: Defines z-order, partial occlusion and contact shadows.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: May improve physical compositing; unvalidated.

rules.name: Material Response Matching
rules.purpose: Make inserted media inherit plausible gloss, reflection, shadow and light direction.
rules.promptRole: Matches physical appearance across edited and original regions.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: May reduce pasted-on appearance; unvalidated.

rules.name: Replication Consistency
rules.purpose: Keep multiple copies of one portrait identical in a layout.
rules.promptRole: Sets copy count and cross-cell consistency.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Complex direct layout may drift; deterministic post-layout is preferred.
avoidFor: runtime generation when post-layout is available

rules.name: Brand and Officiality Guard
rules.purpose: Avoid copying third-party logos or implying official acceptance.
rules.promptRole: Blocks or routes branded document-look requests and compliance claims.
rules.expectedNanoBananaEffect: Policy behavior, not image quality behavior.
